url: str = Field(index=True, unique=True, description="Original URL entered by user")

reasoning: The helper performs a pre-insert duplicate read and then commits a row protected by a unique URL constraint. Two simultaneous POST /youtube requests for the same new URL can both pass the read; one commit succeeds and the other raises a database IntegrityError instead of returning the documented 409-style duplicate response.
reproduction: Issue two parallel POST /api/media/youtube requests with the same new URL. Depending on timing, one request can fail at session.commit() with an uncaught unique constraint violation.
recommendation: Wrap commit in IntegrityError handling, roll back the session, and translate unique URL violations to HTTP 409. Keep the existing pre-check for the normal path, but do not rely on it for correctness under concurrency.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for POST /youtube, and repository search did not find concurrent duplicate-create tests for media feeds.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a unit or API-level test that monkeypatches session.commit to raise sqlalchemy.exc.IntegrityError for _create_media_feed and asserts POST /youtube returns 409 after rollback, plus an integration-style duplicate-create test if the test database setup supports it.
minimumFixScope: Handle IntegrityError around the insert/reactivation commit path in _create_media_feed and add regression coverage for duplicate create failure handling.
